definition: [ כרבל ] verb either denominative be-mantle (from Biblical Aramaic כַּרְבְּלָא Dan 3:21 , if this = mantle , and not ( Marti Gl. ) = Assyrian karballatu , cap (but 'Kriegs[?]-Mantel,' Zehnpf BAS ii, 535 )), or possibly quadril. bind round (from כבל , with insert ר ); — only Pu`al Passive participle מְכֻרְבָּל בִּמְעִיל בּוּץ 1Chr 15:27 bemantled with a robe of byssus.
